description: This file defines the UserSettingsDelegate class, which manages user settings and notifications related to accessibility and localization features, interfacing with IUserSettings COM interface and handling events/notifications.

classes.name: UserSettingsDelegate
classes.description: Manages user settings and notifications, interfacing with IUserSettings COM interface, handling subscription, event processing, and notification dispatching.

classes.name: UserSettingsNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements IUserSettings::INotification to handle user settings change events and dispatch corresponding notifications.

methods.name: HandleSubscription
methods.description: Manages subscription to user settings notifications based on event and listen flag.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Checks if event is relevant and handles subscription accordingly.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsInterface
methods.description: Retrieves IUserSettings interface via shell query, with lazy initialization.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Retrieves voice guidance setting from IUserSettings.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves audio description setting from IUserSettings.

methods.name: GetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether audio descriptions are enabled.

methods.name: GetHighContrast
methods.description: Retrieves high contrast setting.

methods.name: GetCaptions
methods.description: Retrieves captions setting.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Sets voice guidance setting.

methods.name: SetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables audio descriptions.

methods.name: SetCaptions
methods.description: Enables or disables captions.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Sets voice guidance rate.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Retrieves voice guidance hints setting.

methods.name: GetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves presentation language, extracts language code before '-'

methods.name: GetLocale
methods.description: Retrieves full locale string.

methods.name: SetLocale
methods.description: Sets presentation language/locale.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves preferred audio languages as JSON array.

methods.name: GetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves preferred captions languages as JSON array, defaults to ["eng"] on error.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred audio languages from JSON array or string.

methods.name: SetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred captions languages from JSON array or string.
